authoringExclusions.reason: Heading currently inherits the public UI family while the monospace stack remains fixed. Symbol families are now separately validated for complete Morinus glyph coverage before activation.
Shell motion remains internal until a public profile can validate reduced-motion behavior and retained-surface transition timing together.
The complete hover-flag shadow is centralized in CSS but remains runtime-only because profile imports do not yet validate complex shadow stacks.
The legacy UI scale currently affects only the body base font rather than the full component metric system.
These values are measured or supplied by their React layout owners and are not design-profile inputs.

tokens.label: Interactive accent
tokens.description: Fill for selected/current rows and secondary interaction emphasis; this is not a decorative brand color.
safetyNotes: Review dark/light modes, affected surfaces, and recorded contrast pairs before changing this role.

tokens.label: Interactive accent foreground
tokens.description: Text and glyph foreground over selected rows and other interactive accent fills.
safetyNotes: Maintain normal-text contrast against the interactive accent.

tokens.label: Applying-aspect marker size
tokens.description: Leg size of the applying-aspect corner triangle.
safetyNotes: Keep the marker visible without covering the aspect glyph.

tokens.label: Aspect-matrix axis glyph size
tokens.description: Morinus glyph size used for matrix row and column axes.
safetyNotes: Keep axis glyphs legible and smaller than the configured matrix cell.

tokens.label: Aspect-matrix cell size
tokens.description: Square cell size shared by the planetary and fixed-star aspect matrices.
safetyNotes: Keep glyph, orb, marker, and inset roles inside each square at the selected size.

tokens.label: Exact-aspect frame inset
tokens.description: Distance from a cell edge to its exact-aspect inset frame.
safetyNotes: Keep the exact frame distinct from both the outer rule and cell content.

tokens.label: Fixed-star name rail width
tokens.description: Width reserved for fixed-star names before aspect columns begin.
safetyNotes: Check long fixed-star names and horizontal scrolling at narrow values.

tokens.label: Aspect glyph horizontal inset
tokens.description: Horizontal inset for an aspect glyph inside its matrix cell.
safetyNotes: Coordinate with applying-marker size and parallel-marker inset.

tokens.label: Aspect glyph vertical inset
tokens.description: Vertical inset for an aspect glyph inside its matrix cell.
safetyNotes: Keep the glyph clear of the orb line at the bottom of the cell.

tokens.label: Aspect orb bottom inset
tokens.description: Bottom inset for orb text inside each matrix cell.
safetyNotes: Keep orb text within the cell and clear of the aspect glyph.

tokens.label: Aspect-matrix outer padding
tokens.description: Inset between the scroll viewport and the matrix grid.
safetyNotes: Retain enough viewport area for large professional matrices.

tokens.label: Parallel marker horizontal inset
tokens.description: Right inset for parallel and contraparallel markers.
safetyNotes: Keep the marker distinct from the primary aspect glyph.

tokens.label: Parallel marker vertical inset
tokens.description: Top inset for parallel and contraparallel markers.
safetyNotes: Keep the marker distinct from the orb line below it.

tokens.label: Aspect-matrix rule width
tokens.description: Stroke width for cell rules and exact-aspect inset frames.
safetyNotes: Interior cells draw adjacent rules, so verify dense matrices at the upper bound.
